_comment: Atlas evaluation plate set for the VolFill investigation. Categories follow the brief. 'truth' marks plates with real photographed hidden-geometry truth via the G5 rig (sh001, measured 14.6 m baseline). Paths are machine-local by necessity (source plates are not in the repo); regenerate with the same categories on another box.

plates.name: sh001_street

truth.note: 14.6 m measured baseline, registration verified 0.1 px. The one plate with real hidden truth.

plates.expect: deep exterior — resolution gate should bite hard here

plates.name: dsc2289_street
plates.expect: the existing occlusion-slate fixture; ~200 m extent, ~78 cm voxels

plates.name: cathedral_nave
plates.expect: shallow interior — the regime VolFill was trained for; columns are ideal occluders

plates.name: scifi_hangar
plates.expect: interior, big volume — tests the interior/exterior boundary

plates.name: jungleruins
plates.expect: the known-hard foliage case; fragmented predictions historically shred the relief mesh

plates.name: templecity
plates.expect: AI plate; known to solve to assumed_default scale — depth scale registration is the thing to watch

plates.name: newyork_birdseye
plates.expect: extreme obliquity + very deep; worst case for an isotropic bbox

plates.name: coastal_alley
plates.expect: alley walls are a clean amodal-completion target

plates.name: oceancastle
plates.expect: natural geometry; no man-made priors to lean on

plates.name: portal
plates.expect: a portal is the archetypal 'what is behind it' test

plates.name: golden_corridor

truth.note: Atlas golden fixture — geometry is known by construction

plates.expect: low texture + known geometry; isolates whether failures are appearance- or geometry-driven

coverage_gaps: partly-hidden car — no suitable plate found in the available sets
furniture — nearest is golden_corridor / cathedral_nave, neither is actually furniture
Blender-rendered labelled-visibility scenes (VISIBLE/OCCLUDED/OUT_OF_FRUSTUM/UNSUPPORTED) not yet generated
